project_name.justification: The article is titled 'Honey Badger Strategically Adds to Land Position at Plata, Yukon' and refers to the company's 'wholly owned Plata Project'.

company_name.justification: The press release is issued by 'Honey Badger Silver Inc. (TSXV: TUF) ("Honey Badger " or the "Company")'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The article quotes 'Honey Badger's CEO, Dorian L. (Dusty) Nicol' and lists him as CEO at the end of the release.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction involved a full transfer of the new claims. 'ECEE has transferred ownership of the claims to Honey Badger at no cost...'

primary_commodity.justification: While the project has historical silver mineralization, this specific acquisition is targeting gold. The new interpretation is of a 'Reduced Intrusion Related Gold System' or RIRGS, and the retained royalty is specific to gold: 'subject to a 2% net smelter royalty ("NSR") on future commercial gold production. The NSR applies only to gold.'

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the Plata project, as stated in the headline: 'Honey Badger Strategically Adds to Land Position at Plata, Yukon'.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Honey Badger Silver Inc., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange, a Canadian exchange, as shown in the text '(TSXV: TUF)' and the detailed quote 'Exchange: TSXV'.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The transaction was completed without a cash component: 'ECEE has transferred ownership of the claims to Honey Badger at no cost...'

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction was completed without a share component: 'ECEE has transferred ownership of the claims to Honey Badger at no cost...'

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The transaction was completed without a financial consideration: 'ECEE has transferred ownership of the claims to Honey Badger at no cost...'

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, which was 'at no cost'.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in meters was mentioned in the article.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No exploration commitment value was mentioned in the article.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The seller retained a 2% NSR on future gold production as part of the transaction terms. 'ECEE has transferred ownership of the claims to Honey Badger at no cost, subject to a 2% net smelter royalty ("NSR") on future commercial gold production.'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The acquired claims cover a specific area: 'The new claims are adjacent to the Plata Project, comprise 69 individual claims covering 1,430 hectares...'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the acquired area is specified as hectares: '...covering 1,430 hectares...'

resource_size.justification: The article mentions historical resources for other projects owned by the company (Sunrise Lake, Clear Lake) but does not provide any mineral resource estimate for the Plata project itself.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are explicitly mentioned in the first paragraph: 'Honey Badger Silver Inc. (TSXV: TUF)'.
